headline: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.
summary: Focuses on eradicating extreme income poverty and reducing other forms of poverty by improving access to basic services, social protection, and opportunities for decent livelihoods.
key_targets: Eliminate extreme income poverty for all people.
Reduce the proportion of people living in poverty according to national definitions.
Implement social protection systems and build resilience to economic, social, and climate-related shocks.

business_examples.title: Inclusive hiring and living wages
business_examples.description: Create decent jobs for low-income and marginalized groups while ensuring fair wages and social protection benefits.

headline: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.
summary: Addresses undernourishment, food insecurity, and malnutrition while supporting sustainable and resilient agricultural systems that protect ecosystems and rural livelihoods.
key_targets: End hunger and ensure access to safe, nutritious, and sufficient food all year round.
End all forms of malnutrition, especially in children and vulnerable groups.
Promote sustainable, resilient agricultural practices that increase productivity and help maintain ecosystems.

business_examples.title: Climate-smart agriculture services
business_examples.description: Provide digital advisory tools, inputs, and finance to smallholder farmers to improve yields, reduce losses, and adapt to climate risks.

headline: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.
summary: Covers universal access to essential health services, reduction of maternal and child mortality, combating communicable and non-communicable diseases, and promoting mental health and wellbeing.
key_targets: Reduce maternal and child mortality and preventable deaths.
Strengthen prevention and treatment of communicable and non-communicable diseases.
Achieve universal health coverage and access to quality essential health-care services and medicines.

business_examples.title: Affordable digital health platforms
business_examples.description: Offer telemedicine, remote diagnostics, and preventive health services for low- and middle-income communities.

headline: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.
summary: Promotes universal access to free, equitable, and quality primary and secondary education, affordable vocational and higher education, and relevant skills for decent work and active citizenship.
key_targets: Ensure all girls and boys complete quality primary and secondary education.
Increase access to affordable technical, vocational, and tertiary education.
Promote relevant skills for employment, decent jobs, and entrepreneurship, including digital and green skills.

business_examples.title: Edtech for underserved learners
business_examples.description: Provide low-cost or subsidized digital learning platforms, content, and devices to schools and learners in low-resource settings.

headline: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.
summary: Focuses on eliminating discrimination, violence, and harmful practices against women and girls; ensuring equal participation and leadership; and securing equal access to economic resources and opportunities.
key_targets: End all forms of discrimination and violence against women and girls.
Eliminate harmful practices such as child, early, and forced marriage.
Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership in political, economic, and public life.

business_examples.title: Gender-inclusive workplaces
business_examples.description: Adopt equal pay policies, gender-sensitive hiring and promotion practices, anti-harassment mechanisms, and flexible work arrangements to support women’s careers.

headline: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.
summary: Aims to secure universal access to safe drinking water, adequate sanitation, and hygiene, while protecting water-related ecosystems and improving water use efficiency across sectors.
key_targets: Achieve universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water.
Achieve access to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene for all.
Improve water-use efficiency and protect water-related ecosystems such as rivers, lakes, and wetlands.

business_examples.title: Water-efficient industrial processes
business_examples.description: Retrofit facilities to reduce freshwater withdrawals, recycle process water, and minimize water pollution across operations and supply chains.

headline: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.
summary: Seeks universal access to modern energy services, a higher share of renewables in the global energy mix, and significant improvements in energy efficiency.
key_targets: Ensure universal access to affordable, reliable, and modern energy services.
Substantially increase the share of renewable energy in the global energy mix.
Double the rate of improvement in energy efficiency.

business_examples.title: Distributed renewable energy solutions
business_examples.description: Deploy rooftop solar, mini-grids, and energy-as-a-service models that provide clean, reliable power for households and small businesses.

headline: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all.
summary: Promotes sustained economic growth, productive employment, and decent work with safe working conditions, workers’ rights, and opportunities for youth, women, and vulnerable groups.
key_targets: Sustain per capita economic growth and productivity through diversification, innovation, and technological upgrading.
Achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men, including young people and persons with disabilities.
Protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments.

business_examples.title: Formalizing informal work
business_examples.description: Create formal, contracted roles with social protection and safe conditions for workers previously engaged informally in value chains.

headline: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.
summary: Focuses on quality, reliable, sustainable infrastructure; inclusive and sustainable industrial development; and innovation ecosystems that support research, technology diffusion, and access for small enterprises.
key_targets: Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure to support economic development and human well-being.
Promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and raise industry’s share of employment and GDP.
Increase scientific research, upgrade technological capabilities, and encourage innovation, especially for small and medium enterprises.

business_examples.title: Sustainable industrial parks
business_examples.description: Design and operate industrial zones with resource-efficient infrastructure, shared services, and low-carbon technologies that support local SMEs.

headline: Reduce inequality within and among countries.
summary: Addresses income and opportunity gaps within and between countries by promoting social, economic, and political inclusion, equal opportunities, and fair policies and regulations.
key_targets: Progressively achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 percent of the population at a higher rate than the national average.
Empower and promote the social, economic, and political inclusion of all, irrespective of status or identity.
Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome through fair policies and practices.

business_examples.title: Inclusive products and pricing
business_examples.description: Design products, services, and pricing models that are accessible and affordable to low-income and marginalized customers.

headline: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
summary: Promotes access to adequate housing, sustainable transport, green public spaces, disaster risk reduction, and urban planning that is inclusive and climate-resilient.
key_targets: Ensure access to adequate, safe, and affordable housing and basic services for all.
Provide safe, affordable, accessible, and sustainable transport systems.
Strengthen efforts to protect cultural and natural heritage and reduce the environmental impact of cities.

business_examples.title: Transit-oriented urban development
business_examples.description: Invest in mixed-use, energy-efficient real estate and mobility services that encourage public transport, walking, and cycling.

headline: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.
summary: Encourages resource efficiency, circular economy approaches, waste reduction, sustainable supply chains, and information that enables consumers to make responsible choices.
key_targets: Achieve sustainable management and efficient use of natural resources.
Substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling, and reuse.
Encourage companies to adopt sustainable practices and integrate sustainability information into reporting cycles.

business_examples.title: Circular product-as-a-service models
business_examples.description: Shift from one-off sales to leasing or service models that prioritize repair, refurbishment, and recycling of products at end-of-life.

headline: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.
summary: Covers mitigation of greenhouse gas emissions, climate resilience and adaptation, integration of climate measures into policies, and strengthening capacity for climate-related planning and management.
key_targets: Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters.
Integrate climate change measures into policies, strategies, and planning.
Improve education, awareness, and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation, adaptation, and early warning.

business_examples.title: Science-based emissions reduction
business_examples.description: Set and implement science-based targets to decarbonize operations and value chains in line with global climate goals.

headline: Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development.
summary: Aims to reduce marine pollution, protect and restore ecosystems, regulate harvesting, and support sustainable use of ocean resources, including fisheries and coastal tourism.
key_targets: Prevent and significantly reduce marine pollution of all kinds.
Sustainably manage and protect marine and coastal ecosystems.
Effectively regulate harvesting and end overfishing, illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing.

business_examples.title: Sustainable seafood supply chains
business_examples.description: Source only from certified sustainable fisheries and invest in traceability systems that minimize illegal and destructive fishing.

headline: Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and halt biodiversity loss.
summary: Focuses on conserving terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems, sustainably managing forests, halting land degradation and biodiversity loss, and ensuring fair benefits from use of genetic resources.
key_targets: Ensure the conservation, restoration, and sustainable use of terrestrial and inland freshwater ecosystems.
Promote sustainable management of forests and halt deforestation.
Combat desertification, restore degraded land, and halt biodiversity loss.

business_examples.title: Deforestation-free supply chains
business_examples.description: Commit to sourcing commodities only from regions with verified zero deforestation and support landscape restoration programmes.

headline: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions.
summary: Encourages reductions in violence, access to justice, strong and transparent institutions, anti-corruption, and inclusive decision-making at all levels.
key_targets: Significantly reduce all forms of violence and related deaths.
Promote the rule of law and ensure equal access to justice for all.
Substantially reduce corruption and bribery and develop effective, accountable, and transparent institutions.

business_examples.title: Strong ethics and anti-corruption programmes
business_examples.description: Implement robust compliance systems, whistleblower protection, and transparent reporting to prevent bribery and unethical conduct.

headline: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the global partnership for sustainable development.
summary: Emphasizes finance, technology, capacity-building, trade, and systemic policy coherence, alongside multi-stakeholder partnerships that support implementation of all SDGs.
key_targets: Mobilize financial resources from multiple sources to support sustainable development in all countries.
Enhance international cooperation on access to technology, capacity-building, and data.
Promote effective public, public–private, and civil society partnerships at global, regional, and local levels.

business_examples.title: Multi-stakeholder impact coalitions
business_examples.description: Participate in or lead partnerships with governments, NGOs, and peers to address specific SDG challenges with shared goals and transparent reporting.
